mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.enrollment_id, u.name as student_name, c.name as course_name, a.lecture_date, a.period, a.status, a.remarks FROM attendances a JOIN enrollments e ON a.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN courses c ON l.course_id = c.id WHERE a.enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} ORDER BY a.lecture_date DESC, a.period ASC

SELECT c.name AS course_name, a.lecture_date, a.period, a.status FROM attendances a JOIN enrollments e ON a.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN courses c ON l.course_id = c.id JOIN students st ON e.student_id = st.id WHERE st.user_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY a.lecture_date DESC, a.period ASC

SELECT e.attachment_original_name AS attachmentOriginalName, e.attachment_stored_name AS attachmentStoredName, e.attachment_content_type AS attachmentContentType FROM excuse_requests e JOIN enrollments en ON e.enrollment_id = en.id JOIN students s ON en.student_id = s.id WHERE e.id = #{requestId} AND s.user_id = #{studentId} AND e.attachment_stored_name IS NOT NULL

SELECT er.id, er.enrollment_id, c.name AS course_name, u.name AS student_name, u.login_id AS student_no, er.lecture_date, er.period, er.reason, er.status, er.reject_reason, er.attachment_original_name, er.attachment_content_type, er.attachment_size FROM excuse_requests er JOIN enrollments e ON er.enrollment_id = e.id JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN courses c ON l.course_id = c.id JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE s.user_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY er.created_at DESC
